companyFieldUpdates.description: North Carolina Solar is one five-project operating solar portfolio in North Carolina comprising Brantley, Fox Creek, Buckleberry, Innovative Solar 54 and Innovative Solar 67. John Laing's portfolio page reports 334 MWdc across the five assets, with contracted power sales to Duke Energy Progress and commercial operations beginning from late 2018 into early 2019. John Laing assembled the portfolio in 2018. KKR acquired John Laing Group in September 2021, and Equitix completed its 50% investment in John Laing Investments Limited on October 6, 2021. Direct April 2026 evidence describes JLIL as 50:50 owned by Equitix and KKR-owned John Laing Group. John Laing is preserved as the former sponsor and current KKR-owned asset manager, not a third independent owner. The historic 9.9% ProjectCo/HoldCo minority and its current rights are not publicly disclosed and are not inferred to be tax equity. Granite is a separate eight-project portfolio and is excluded from this company boundary. No later portfolio sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
